findings.description: WHERE clause uses scheduled_at < ? but ORDER BY includes id DESC as tiebreaker. When two deliveries share the same scheduled_at, the cursor skips or duplicates rows across pages because the WHERE filter does not account for the tiebreaker.
findings.reasoning: Review explicitly identifies the tiebreaker mismatch with a concrete example showing how rows get skipped across pages.

findings.description: Cursor extraction changed from index 0 (id) to index 2 (scheduled_at). Consistent with ORDER BY change but changes the API cursor contract.
findings.reasoning: Review notes the cursor contract change from id to timestamp and flags the backward compatibility concern.
